descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink. Classic Stampin' Ink Refills come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of product coordination. * Fast drying, dye-based ink * Old Olive * Acid free * Use to re-ink Classic Stampin’ Pads or use for spritzing or watercoloring * Coordinates with Stampin’ Up! cardstock, markers, and embellishments * 0.5 fl. oz. (14.8 ml)

images.description: A bottle of Stampin' Up Classic Stampin' Ink in Old Olive, a water-based dye ink. The product features a dark olive-colored liquid in a clear glass bottle with a white ribbed cap and dropper applicator. The label displays the product name in English, French, German, and Japanese.

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Old Olive * Acid free * Lignin free
